goals: Verify the Grid.create method handles invalid seed length by throwing an error.
Verify the grid.neighbors method correctly identifies and returns neighbors for various cell positions, including valid and invalid inputs.
activities: Attempt to create a Grid with invalid seed length (3x3 grid, seed "1 0 0 1 1 0").
Expect the Grid creation to throw an error matching a snapshot.
Create a Grid instance (3x3 grid, seed "1 0 0 1 1 0 0 1 0").
Get the neighbors for cell index 7 and expect the result to match a snapshot.
Get the neighbors for cell index -1 and expect the result to match a snapshot.
Get the neighbors for cell index 4 and expect the result to match a snapshot.
Get the neighbors for cell index 0 and expect the result to match a snapshot.
Get the neighbors for cell index 2 and expect the result to match a snapshot.
Get the neighbors for cell index 6 and expect the result to match a snapshot.
Get the neighbors for cell index 8 and expect the result to match a snapshot.
